tool_calls.name: lookup_refund_policy
tool_calls.arguments: {"query":"refund deadline 30 days after delivery time; whether returned unit refund can be requested"}

messages.name: lookup_refund_policy
messages.content: {"ok": true, "sections": [{"citation": "refund-policy/v2/window", "title": "Time limit", "text": "A refund must be requested no later than 30 days after the delivery time recorded on the order. Days are exact periods of twenty-four hours, and a request at exactly the deadline is on time. The request time is the moment the shop creates the refund proposal. If an earlier proposal for the same units was created in time and then expired, or stopped being valid because the order or this policy changed, before it was paid, a later request for those units is not refused for being late: a staff member takes the case. A proposal that the customer replaced or cancelled, that a staff member rejected, or that a handoff closed does not count. A request for an exception to the time limit is refused with this reason."}, {"citation": "refund-policy/v2/return", "title": "Items must be returned first", "text": "The shop refunds only units it has received back, as shown by its own return records, never by a statement of the customer or the assistant. If the records show the units arrived, the request continues normally. If they do not, the shop pays nothing for those units: if the customer says the units were already sent, a staff member checks; if the customer will send them later, the assistant explains that they must arrive first and requests nothing for them now."}, {"citation": "refund-policy/v2/amount", "title": "Refund amount", "text": "The refund for a unit is what was paid for that unit: its price minus its share of any discount. The shares are fixed once, when the order is recorded, and never recalculated: when a paid total is split among identical units, each unit gets the total divided by the number of units, rounded down to the smallest unit of the currency, and what is left over is added one smallest unit at a time to the last units, so no unit is refunded more than its price. Shipping charges are not part of the amount. A unit for which nothing was paid has nothing to refund: a request that includes it is refused, and the other units can be requested without it. Nobody can raise the amount, so a request for more than was paid is refused with this reason."}], "note": "Cite a section by its citation ID, exactly as given."}
